thesis: Pre-open pack for 2026-09-04 is thin: Davos-style attendance news (Dimon/Dalio at a Saudi summit), a Ukraine budget-strain warning, single-company earnings/margin items, and routine politician PTR filings, with no dated, broad-market catalyst for a conservative core-ETF sleeve. Existing VTI position (~22.8 of ~107.8 equity, ~21%) and cash buffer (~85, ~79% of equity, well above the 25% floor) remain within all tier limits (1 of max 4 positions, no name near the 25% cap). Holding rather than forcing a trade on thin evidence, consistent with capital preservation.
